title: Identification of the integral scalar associator representatives
statement:
theorem integral_comp_normalization_bridge
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra (Padic l) F] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) F]
    (G : Type u) [Field G] [Algebra (Padic l) G] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) G]
    (H : Type u) [Field H] [Algebra (Padic l) H] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) H]
    (i : F →ₐ[Padic l] G) (j : G →ₐ[Padic l] H)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l F X) :
    (sfIntegralScalarComp l F G i X 0 (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) H j).hom.app K =
      ObjectProperty.homMk
        (X := (integralScalar l X G H j).obj ((integralScalar l X F G i).obj K))
        (Y := (integralScalar l X F H (j.comp i)).obj K)
        (IntegralFiniteExtension.comp l F G i X H j K.obj K.property.1).hom

source.place: the normalization clause of paragraph 3, associator equation

proof.text: Expand both normalized associators through their completion comparisons and identify the common completed tensor composition component by naturality.

proof_origin.place: the normalization clause of paragraph 3, component identification

mathlib_searches.results: Found the two normalized component constructions; no existing identification theorem.

from.place: component identification used in the normalization clause
